The '''Senate Constitution''' contained the guidelines of the operation and powers of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] overruled it with the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|Dissolution of the Imperial Senate]].
